summary: Re-review of the one changed block (b010); b012–b014 are byte-identical to v1. v1 had no must_fix/should_fix. Notes M2 (brim image) and M3 (untidy heaps) are now matched by 'tot de rand toe vol' and 'vormen kleine hoopjes'; M1 ('verdwijnt achter') was rejected by the translator for a sound reason and is closed. The four rewrites in b010 keep every object, number, the 'zodat' purpose link, the footnote mark and the books as agent of the heaping; nothing added, nothing summarised.

comprehension.q: What covers the walls of the room, and where have the books ended up beyond the bookcases?
comprehension.answer_from_nl: Elke centimeter muur verdwijnt achter een boekenkast met zes planken tot bijna aan het plafond; de boeken stromen over naar de tafels en de banken en vormen kleine hoopjes onder de ramen.

comprehension.q: Why is the back row of paperbacks standing on old tissue boxes or pieces of wood?
comprehension.answer_from_nl: Zodat je die boeken (de achterste rij) boven de voorste kunt zien.

comprehension.q: Whose living room is this, and how is Harry related to the couple?
comprehension.answer_from_nl: Het huis van de eminente professor Michael Verres-Evans en zijn vrouw Petunia Evans-Verres; Harry James Potter-Evans-Verres is hun adoptiezoon.

comprehension.q: What lies on the living-room table, and what is unusual about the envelope?
comprehension.answer_from_nl: Een brief en een envelop van geelachtig perkament, zonder postzegel; op de envelop staat in smaragdgroene inkt 'de heer H. Potter'.

comprehension.q: How are the Professor and his wife arguing, and why are they not shouting?
comprehension.answer_from_nl: Ze praten op scherpe toon tegen elkaar maar schreeuwen niet; de Professor vindt schreeuwen onbeschaafd.

findings.fragment: Elke centimeter muur verdwijnt achter een boekenkast.
findings.problem: Carried from v1 as a record only: 'verdwijnt achter' is a shade more animated than the flat 'is covered by'. The translator rejected the static alternative because it would move the \lettrine off 'Elke'; that reasoning is accepted and the finding is closed.
findings.evidence: EN: 'Every inch of wall space is covered by a bookcase.' vs NL: 'Elke centimeter muur verdwijnt achter een boekenkast.' — unchanged v1 → v2 by decision.
